items.title: Mistral Large 4 ships as a 1T-parameter MoE model
items.summary: Mistral Large 4 ships as a 1 trillion parameter MoE model with 49 billion active parameters, released in preview. It marks Mistral's return to frontier-scale models after sitting out the recent scaling race. Anyone evaluating open frontier-tier options now has a new MoE architecture to benchmark against. (2 minute read)

items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Google's open multimodal embedding model
items.summary: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open, lightweight embedding model that handles multimodal input, under an Apache 2.0 license. That license lets teams fine-tune and redistribute it freely, unlike more restrictive open-weight terms. Anyone building retrieval or RAG pipelines now has a permissively licensed multimodal embedder to drop in. (1 minute read)

items.title: OpenAI shares new AI-generated math proofs, with Lean code on GitHub
items.summary: OpenAI published new results on open mathematics problems generated by an internal frontier model, including Lean proof formalizations posted to GitHub. The proofs are machine-checkable rather than just claimed. Mathematicians can now pull the Lean code directly and verify the results themselves instead of taking the claims on faith. (1 minute read)

items.title: OpenTPU: an open-source AI accelerator built by AI
items.summary: OpenTPU is an open-source AI accelerator design, notable for having been developed by AI rather than human engineers. (1 minute read)

items.title: Meta's Muse draws fire over privacy and security failings
items.summary: Meta's AI assistant Muse has drawn criticism for serious privacy and security failings in how it handles user data. (1 minute read)

items.title: Google open-sources Artemis, an Android automation agent
items.summary: Google open-sourced Artemis, which turns natural-language instructions into Android automation and reports 99%+ task completion on the AndroidWorld benchmark's 100+ tasks across 20+ apps. It ships under Apache 2.0 with a native MCP server for IDE integration. Developers can now wire Android UI automation directly into Claude Code, Windsurf, or similar agent harnesses. (2 minute read)

items.title: OpenAI's early guidelines for frontier AI safety cases
items.summary: OpenAI published early guidelines for building 'safety cases' in frontier AI training, covering technical safeguards, operational practices, and how to investigate misalignment incidents. (1 minute read)

items.title: Dust pretrains transformers without backpropagation
items.summary: Dust is a research project demonstrating transformer pretraining without backpropagation, using an alternative training method published on its project page. (1 minute read)
